title: Studio gate
description: video/<slug>/studio/gates/<gateId>.json. Written by the mod that holds the project when Claude opens a gate; the only later write adds deliveredAt once the reply's wake-up turn has started.

gateId.description: <three-digit sequence>-<stage>; also the file name and the reply's file name.

autoContinue.description: True when the stage was set to auto-continue: the gate tool returned approved at once and no reply is expected.

payload.description: What the studio shows for this stage; its shape per stage is defined by the web studio.

deliveredAt.description: When the reply was delivered to Claude. Present means the reply must never be sent again.
